1.translation: When the sun is wrapped up in darkness,

2.translation: and when the stars fall down,

3.translation: and when the mountains are set in motion,

4.translation: and when pregnant camels[1] are left unattended,
4.footnotes: [1] Which are near delivery. It alludes to the distraction of people from their most valuable possessions, such as ten-month pregnant camels for nomadic Arabs.

5.translation: and when wild beasts are gathered,

6.translation: and when the seas are set on fire,

7.translation: and when the souls are sorted[2],
7.footnotes: [2] i.e., "joined" with their groups or sects, wicked with the wicked souls, righteous with the righteous.

8.translation: and when the baby girl buried alive[3] is asked,
8.footnotes: [3] As the pagan Arabs used to do for fear of shame or poverty. The Qur’an condemned this practice. See 16:58-59.

9.translation: for what crime she was killed,

10.translation: and when records of deeds are spread open,

11.translation: and when the sky is stripped away[4],
11.footnotes: [4] As the skin of sheep is stripped away.

12.translation: and when the Blazing Fire is flared up,

13.translation: and when Paradise is brought near –

14.translation: then every soul will know what it has brought about[5].
14.footnotes: [5] Of faith or disbelief, good or bad deeds for that Day.

15.translation: I swear by the receding stars,

16.footnotes: [6] This probably refers to black holes in the sky. "Kanasa" means sweeping or hiding.

17.translation: and by the night as it departs,

18.translation: and by the day as it breaks –

19.translation: Indeed, this [Qur’an] is a word conveyed by a noble angel-messenger.

20.translation: extremely powerful, highly revered by the Lord of the Throne,

21.translation: obeyed there [by other angels] and trustworthy.

22.translation: Your fellow [i.e., the Prophet] is not a madman.

23.translation: He indeed saw him [i.e., Gabriel] on the clear horizon[7].
23.footnotes: [7] i.e., the eastern horizon, where the sun rises. See footnote 53:6

24.translation: He does not withhold [knowledge of] the unseen[8].
24.footnotes: [8] He (ﷺ) did not withhold the unseen which Allah had revealed to him in the Qur’an.

25.translation: This [Qur’an] is not the word of an accursed devil.

26.translation: So which way are you going[9]?
26.footnotes: [9] In your denial of the Qur’an for being the revelation from Allah.

27.translation: It is but a reminder to the worlds,

28.translation: for those among you who wish to take the straight path.

29.translation: But you cannot wish except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
